## Objectives {#objectives}

By the end of this session you can:

- Extract tables from born-digital and scanned PDFs.
- Use the totals printed on a page as reconciliation targets.
- Choose between OCR, a vision model, and hand entry.
- Name the two signature failure modes: partial extraction and
  fabrication.

## What we cover {#coverage}

- What the archives hold: historical statistics, filings, government
  reports — full of tables nobody has mined.
- Born-digital vs scanned: two different problems.
- OCR vs vision-language models; multi-page tables; page images as
  model input.

**Verification habit.** Reconcile extracted totals against the totals
printed on the page — the document carries its own check.
